name: readly-mcp
description: MCP server for scraping Readly magazines

tools.name: api_content_match
tools.description: Search watch-list magazines on Readly for articles matching a query (e.g. arXiv paper title).

tools.name: api_pipeline_liveness
tools.description: Fleet probe: auth token, browser, scrape job state.

tools.name: api_set_auth_token
tools.description: Set the Readly auth token (stored in env, not persisted to disk).

tools.name: api_update_settings
tools.description: Update runtime settings (stored in env for current session).

tools.name: api_update_llm_settings
tools.description: Update LLM provider settings for the session.

tools.name: api_list_llm_models
tools.description: List available models from the configured LLM provider.

tools.name: api_llm_chat
tools.description: Send a chat message to the configured LLM.

tools.name: api_llm_providers
tools.description: Discover local LLM providers (Ollama, LM Studio) and their models.

tools.name: api_llm_status
tools.description: Check connectivity to the configured LLM provider.
